sources.scope: 115 unique full parcel polygons returned through 13 bounded 0.001-degree cells around the WUP locator. All 13 viewport reads, forced 3-row paging (18 features across six pages), 115 fresh exact-ID reads, explicit absent-ID semantics, a footprint query, and source binding passed through the existing ArcGIS adapter. All fresh geometries matched viewport hashes. The exact WUP locator is outside all retained polygons. This verifies a local sample only; city-boundary coverage and citywide completeness remain unverified. The GBRA-hosted item is a 2022 TNRIS-acquired snapshot attributed to Bexar CAD, not a live BCAD/SARA feed. The sample does not establish current assessor state, city boundary coverage, or legal survey accuracy.
